about: Landmarks in Marigona Residence, researched in November 2026 from news, hotel and school listings and OpenStreetMap. Summaries are written for this map from those sources; follow the links for more. Anchors: 'osm' = a clickable building (its OSM way), otherwise a label point.

landmarks.name: Marigona Residence
landmarks.summary: A self-contained villa estate in Preoc, just south of Prishtinë, with its own shops, cafés, a hotel and an international school around a central square. Prishtina Insight called it the best known of Kosovo's exclusive gated neighbourhoods, with homes selling for roughly €200,000–500,000.

links.title: Prishtina Insight on Kosovo's gated neighbourhoods

landmarks.name: Four Points by Sheraton
landmarks.local: Four Points by Sheraton Prishtina City
landmarks.summary: Marriott-brand hotel at the estate's centre (California street 52): 87 rooms on five floors, with meeting rooms used for conferences and events.

links.title: Four Points by Sheraton Prishtina City (Marriott)

landmarks.name: International School of Prishtina
landmarks.summary: Private international day school on the estate, run by Mehmet Akif Schools according to OpenStreetMap; school directories list it for ages 6–18.
